name: South FL Catering at The Events Center
address: 6101 NW 31st St, Margate, FL 33063, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Gregory Todd
reviewSamples.text: This place is well maintained. The staff took thevtime to give us a tour of the facility including the food preparation area. Cooking isn't allowed but they have hot boxes with warming capabilities, refrigerators and tables.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Chantay Pinkney
reviewSamples.text: We had our Leader's ApostleJohn L.Mohorn Jr & Elect Lady Delbert Mohorn 30 year Pastoral Anniversary. The Word Of The Living God Ministries. The Place was the prefect location, to host this event, the seating was comfortable, the place was well maintained. And the locationwas easy to find.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Lori Wilk
reviewSamples.text: I am a new fan of this Event Center and plan to host events, workshops, AI education,conferences, continuing education programs, seminars, speaker and entertainer showcases here soon. It’s what I’ve been looking for as an Executive Producer of Talk Shows and Events in Broward, Palm Beach and Dade Counties.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Larissa Salvador
reviewSamples.text: Hosted my event at the event center for the first time. Great, spacious area. Plenty of parking, and ready to go.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Paula Thompson
reviewSamples.text: I had my baby shower here, invited about 60 people and used the Onyx room. I loved the entire experience the facility lobby is so lovely! My room was nice and spacious! My guest loved the place. Michael has some of the BEST customer service I have ever experienced he is super informative and reliable. Thank you guys for the wonderful experience!
